title: AI & Technology Risk Auditor - Lead Consultant
description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. Your role in the team Internal Audit provides independent assurance and advisory services that help Allstate manage risk, strengthen controls, and improve business performance. As emerging technologies transform the organization, Internal Audit plays a critical role in evaluating the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control frameworks across technology, data, and AI-enabled solutions. The Lead AI & Technology Risk Auditor is a senior audit professional responsible for leading complex technology and business audits across high-risk and emerging technology domains, with a particular focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), advanced analytics platforms, and cloud-native technologies. This role serves as both an audit leader and subject matter expert, designing and executing audit strategies that evaluate the effectiveness of technology controls, AI governance practices, model risk management, automation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making systems. The Lead AI & Technology Risk Auditor provides independent assurance over AI-enabled solutions while helping the audit function evolve through the adoption of AI-assisted auditing techniques, data analytics, automation, and innovative audit methodologies. Working closely with business leaders, technology partners, risk functions, and audit teams, this individual influences audit strategy, mentors auditors, and helps ensure that Allstate's adoption of AI technologies remains secure, compliant, ethical, and appropriately governed. Key Responsibilities: Independently lead complex technology, cyber, data, and AI-focused audits from planning through reporting, ensuring delivery of high-quality audit outcomes within agreed timelines. Develop and execute risk-based audit programs that assess governance, risk management, and control effectiveness across technology platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and data solutions. Evaluate controls supporting the design, development, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing governance of AI and machine learning solutions. Assess generative AI and large language model (LLM) implementations, including model governance, prompt engineering controls, output validation processes, data privacy protections, and third-party AI service provider oversight. Apply data analytics, automation, and AI-assisted audit techniques to improve audit effectiveness, perform full-population testing, identify anomalies, and uncover emerging risks. Conduct walkthroughs, control assessments, testing procedures, and root cause analysis for complex technology and business processes. Communicate audit observations and recommendations through sprint reviews, stakeholder discussions, and formal audit reports. Partner with technology and business leaders to understand strategic initiatives, emerging risks, and evolving regulatory requirements. Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical guidance to audit team members in areas including technology risk, AI governance, data analytics, control evaluation, and strategic thinking. Contribute to Internal Audit transformation initiatives through the development of innovative audit methodologies, AI-enabled audit practices, continuous monitoring capabilities, and automation solutions. Maintain awareness of emerging AI regulations, industry standards, and technology trends, incorporating them into audit planning and execution. Essential Skills: All applicants must demonstrate they have a legal right to work in the UK for employment at Allstate. Allstate is not providing sponsorship for this vacancy. A minimum of 4 years of experience in Internal Audit, External Audit, Risk Management, Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, or Technology Control functions within a regulated or large enterprise environment. A minimum of 1 year of professional experience auditing, implementing, assessing, governing, or supporting AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Advanced Analytics solutions. Practical experience with at least one analytical or technical tool such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, SAS, or equivalent. Proven experience presenting audit findings, risk assessments, or technology control recommendations to senior management and business stakeholders. Desirable Skills: Professional certification including CISA, CIA, CPA, CFE, CA, CRISC, CISSP, or equivalent. AI-related certifications such as: ISACA AI Fundamentals ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) AWS AI Certifications Microsoft Azure AI Certifications Data Science or Machine Learning certificatio

This role will work closely with the Model Risk Management and Information Security teams while maintaining a distinct mandate: Data & AI Governance will establish enterprise governance and responsible-use standards, while Model Risk Management will retain responsibility for model inventory, tiering, validation, and model-risk oversight. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise Data and AI Governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating model. Establish clear accountability for data ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, classification, access, retention, and appropriate use. Maintain an enterprise inventory of material data assets, AI use cases, and related governance decisions in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Define risk-based classifications and governance requirements based on the sensitivity, complexity, materiality, and customer or regulatory impact of each use case. Establish governance for internally developed, vendor-provided, and embedded AI capabilities, including generative AI. Partner with various Product, Engineering, Data, and business teams to embed governance requirements into development and change-management processes. Support relevant Data and AI governance forums/committees and facilitate timely, well-documented decisions. Promote a culture in which data is treated as an enterprise asset and AI is used responsibly, transparently, and in alignment with Mercury’s risk appetite. Qualifications: 10+ years of relevant experience in data governance, AI governance, technology risk, information governance, model risk, privacy, compliance, or a related discipline. Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing a data governance, AI governance, or responsible-AI program. Strong understanding of data ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, metadata, classification, access, retention, and lifecycle management. Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning concepts, including generative AI, large language models, training and inference data, explainability, bias, performance monitoring, and human oversight. Experience developing practical, risk-based policies and governance processes that can operate effectively in a fast-moving technology environment. Ability to distinguish among data governance, AI governance, model risk, information security, privacy, and compliance responsibilities while coordinating effectively across those functions. Strong judgment and the ability to balance innovation, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, and risk management. Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, technical teams, and business leaders without relying solely on formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and risk concepts to executive and Board audiences. title: Founding Engineer (Tech Lead)
description: The Context Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do. Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows. We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath. The Mission You'll own the outcomes. You take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into clear requirements, a design with clear business rationale, sequenced work, and a realistic estimate, build the hardest parts yourself, and multiply a team of mid-level engineers with well-defined, extensible work and the reviews that keep quality high. You stay an IC at heart while making the work legible, sized, and worth doing. This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin. Your responsibilities Deliver the highest-risk work yourself: Be the IC where it matters. Personally engineer the most complex, business-critical components, from cross-service logic to the boundary where AI outputs become deterministic, auditable actions, and set the technical bar for the team as you go. Turn business goals into shipped projects: Take an ambiguous problem and own it through to delivery, defining requirements, a design that starts from customer impact and takes the highest-ROI path whether it's make or buy, sequenced work, estimates, and clear engineering acceptance criteria a team can execute with minimal churn. Design complex systems that don’t break down in 12 months: Architect entire systems so the likely next requirement plugs in cleanly through configuration or a new adapter, keeping components reusable and loosely coupled, separating business logic from shared services, and maintaining a single authoritative, append-only source of truth for critical data - including consideration of make-or-buy options. Scale the team's autonomy and quality: Set decision thresholds so engineers self-serve low-stakes calls, define sanctioned paths for experimenting with regulated data, and spread understanding of our systems to cut key-person risk. Settle design in review, then build the road to production: CI/CD with quality gates, automated migrations, and systems that report their own health. Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request, and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters made my day!”? Your profile Experience: Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus. IC strength: A hands-on builder who ships the hard things, and who naturally thinks in business outcomes, work packages, ROI, and extensibility. Project definition: Proven ability to write requirements and designs from business context, break them into estimated, sequenced work, and drive a project to completion in a tool like Linear. Technical proficiency: Deep proficiency in Python is mandatory, with strong command of REST API design, relational data modeling, and layered, service-oriented architecture. AI-native: Real experience building LLM/agentic tooling, and understanding how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code. Natural leader: You lift the people around you through design review, coaching, and clear direction, and you enjoy doing it. Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people. What We Offer Ownership of whole product areas: Latitude to shape what we build and how we scope, sequence, and ship it, with a team to build it with. Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before. We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time. Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up. Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together. Our stack Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs. Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running. AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity. Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.
